aboutRtl.title: Arabic RTL without duplicate layouts
aboutRtl.intro: This page explains the mirroring approach used across the demo. One component tree serves all locales; direction is driven by the html dir attribute.

sections.title: dir="rtl" on <html>
sections.body: When the locale is Arabic, the root layout sets lang="ar" and dir="rtl". The browser flips the inline axis so start becomes the right edge.

sections.title: CSS logical properties
sections.body: Spacing and alignment use logical utilities such as ms-/me-, ps-/pe-, text-start, and start-/end- instead of left/right. Margins and padding therefore mirror automatically.

sections.title: Shared components
sections.body: Header, cards, and forms are not forked for Arabic. The language switcher preserves the current path so visitors stay on the same page while changing locale.

aboutRtl.note: This keeps maintenance low and makes a future headless CMS swap straightforward — content changes, layout logic stays the same.
